lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: sequences as functions on the integers
lessonRef.title: Unit assessment: sequences as functions on the integers

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Unit assessment. Work alone, show your steps, and check your work before you finish.

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 9)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 35 components and consumes 7 per hour. It can run for at most 10 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 35 − 7h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = -5 and a(n) = a(n − 1) + 2 for n > 1. Find a(14).
In a modelling context, the graph of a projectile’s height against time crosses the horizontal axis. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: the average rate of change over the flight
a zero, giving the time the projectile returns to ground level
the maximum, giving the greatest height
the y-intercept, giving the launch height

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4), (5, 4)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 120 components and consumes 3 per hour. It can run for at most 14 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 120 − 3h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = 3 and a(n) = a(n − 1) − 3 for n > 1. Find a(24).
In a modelling context, the graph of a cooling object’s temperature flattens out towards a horizontal line. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: an end behaviour approaching the surrounding temperature
an interval of increase
a zero, giving the time the object freezes
a maximum, giving the hottest temperature

items.prompt: Does the relation x = y², for real y define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.
No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
